verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting product offers customizable heatmaps to track 'key metrics' and conversational Ask AI queries, plus Watchtower for flagging criteria, indicating a dashboard/analytics capability exists — but no evidence explicitly names resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, or cost per resolution as tracked metrics. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming CSAT, resolution rate, handoff rate, and cost per resolution as dashboard metrics; independent/customer confirmation of exec-level reporting use.
